decision.authority_and_scope: Proposed local source contract only. Independent code review is pending; G retains formal acceptance and finding adjudication. No 13-supplier or whole-I1 closure is proposed.
basis: hash_payload({producer_config: _producer_config_snapshot(config)}) binds current material inputs and profile coverage from one immutable effective profile snapshot; the selected profile must be covered and state none for review retention.

The persisted complete basis includes every CatalogTransportDataset dataclass field and every VariableAlignment model field for the complete competing-candidate group, plus selected profile/material identity.

The canonical versioned sidecar is content-recomputed and schema-validated before review reuse. Missing, malformed, forged, unbound legacy, or changed basis clears prior review annotations; ds_variable_alignments.evidence remains unchanged.
Catalog/legacy registry datasets, audit annotations, alignment rows, and sidecar replacement are one transaction. A real failure injected after the alignment write rolls all four relations back.
Review flags remain audit annotations; this mechanism grants no authority and proves no downstream review-authority consumer or production currentness.
decision.claim: Preserve existing catalog review annotations only when the complete producer alignment group and its effective source/profile material basis recompute exactly.
decision.migration: Historical rows without a versioned recomputable sidecar basis are not upgraded by declaration; the next producer replay clears their review annotations. Catalog and legacy registry/audit/alignment/basis writes commit or roll back together. A full graph/database replacement clears the sidecar with its related alignment state. No production migration is authorized.

profile_snapshot.compatibility: Existing get/list_all live-object behavior is unchanged. register/override is covered by the lock-coherent snapshot. Direct in-place mutation of a live model returned by get/list_all bypasses the lock and remains an explicit bounded residual; the companion manifest contains a deterministic counterexample and the options/impact for G.
profile_snapshot.mechanism: SourceProfileRegistry.snapshot_all deep-copies registered profiles under the existing state lock. One private runtime snapshot resolves connection configs, execution policies, excluded-input coverage, profile payload, UNPD token overlay and legacy serial toggle; a ContextVar carries it across pipeline, direct ingest, receipt/currentness, and resume consumers.

decision.selected_pattern: Reuse ds_variable_alignments and ds_alignment_audit; persist the complete producer/profile material basis in one versioned sidecar keyed to the complete dataset/alignment group. Preserve the existing human-authored evidence bytes and public DTO semantics.
decision.storage_impact: One internal operational sidecar is now implemented with a canonical exact schema. Producer evidence bytes, public DatasetMatch DTO/evidence and selected-catalog credal reference hash are invariant under sidecar-only mutation; no production migration or public DTO change is performed.
decision.time_semantics: Basis currentness is recomputed from current material at each producer pass. resolved_at remains an audit resolution time and is preserved only for an exact unchanged basis; it is not treated as source freshness or an external currentness assertion.
